mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(sys31_leave_company_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY leaveSeq, spcLeaveSeq)) AS leave_company_id , COALESCE(sys31_leave_cd, leaveCode) AS leave_code , COALESCE(sys31_spc_leave_cd, spcLeaveCode) AS spc_leave_code , sys31_days AS days , COALESCE(sys31_calc_cd,'2') AS calc_code , COALESCE(sys31_un_use_yn,'false') = 'true' AS un_use_yn , sys31_note AS note , f_cdnm('leaveCode' , leaveCode , #{companyId}, f_today()) AS leave_name , f_cdnm('SpecialLeaveCode' , spcLeaveCode , #{companyId}, f_today()) AS spc_leave_name , f_cdnm('LeaveDaysCalcType', COALESCE(sys31_calc_cd,'2'), #{companyId}, f_today()) AS calc_name FROM ( SELECT t1.* , spcLeaveCode , spcLeaveName , spcLeaveSeq FROM ( SELECT sys09_code leaveCode , sys09_name leaveName , sys09_seq leaveSeq FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code a1 ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'leaveCode' AND sys09_company_id = 0 AND COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'false' AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT MAX(a2.sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code a2 WHERE a2.sys09_code_kind_id = a1.sys09_code_kind_id AND a2.sys09_code = a1.sys09_code AND a2.sys09_company_id = a1.sys09_company_id AND a2.sys09_apply_date <= f_today() ) ) t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT sys09_code spcLeaveCode , sys09_name spcLeaveName , sys09_seq spcLeaveSeq , '04' leaveCode FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code b1 ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'SpecialLeaveCode' AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'false' AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT MAX(b2.sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code b2 WHERE b2.sys09_code_kind_id = b1.sys09_code_kind_id AND b2.sys09_code = b1.sys09_code AND b2.sys09_company_id = b1.sys09_company_id AND b2.sys09_apply_date <= f_today() ) ) t2 ON t2.leaveCode = t1.leaveCode ) tt LEFT OUTER JOIN sys31_leave_company ON ( sys31_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys31_leave_cd = leaveCode AND ( ( sys31_leave_cd = '04' AND sys31_spc_leave_cd = spcLeaveCode ) OR ( sys31_leave_cd != '04' ) ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys31_leave_company ( sys31_leave_company_id, sys31_company_id, sys31_leave_cd, sys31_spc_leave_cd , sys31_days, sys31_calc_cd, sys31_un_use_yn, sys31_note ) VALUES ( #{leaveCompanyId}, #{companyId}, #{leaveCode}, #{spcLeaveCode} , #{days}, #{calcCode}, #{unUseYn}, #{note} )
